terminalAudit.redactedCommand:
bash -lc python3 - <<'PY'
with open('/app/admin-tool','rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
# .rodata file offset 0x8d000, vaddr 0x48d000
def v2o(v): return v - 0x48d000 + 0x8d000
t=0x4aa99e
print(repr(data[v2o(t)-20:v2o(t)+60]))
print(repr(data[v2o(t):v2o(t)+15]))
print(repr(data[v2o(t):v2o(t)+16]))
# also dump strings near main messages: resolve LEAQs from objdump
# main.go:18 LEAQ 0x8eca(IP) at 0x48bdaf -> target 0x48bdaf+7+0x8eca = ?
for pc,off in [(0x48bdaf,0x8eca),(0x48bdb6+7,0),(0x48bdf9,0x8e80),(0x48be08-7,0)]:
    pass
targets = [(0x48bdaf,0x8eca),(0x48bdf9,0x8e80),(0x48beba,0x8dbf),(0x48bf0e,0x8d6b),(0x48bfbf,0x8cba),(0x48bf5d,0x2569f),(0x48bf69-7,0x1f981),(0x48bfa6-7,0x1ea07)]
for pc,off in targets:
    # LEAQ is 7 bytes: pc is addr of LEA insn start, target = pc+7+off
    t2 = pc+7+off
    print(hex(pc), hex(off), hex(t2), repr(data[v2o(t2):v2o(t2)+80]))
PY
